notes.title: Apology and notice regarding postponement of Season 2 release
notes.notes:
[Apology and notice regarding postponement of Season 2 release]

Regarding "Project F Season 2" scheduled for November 2023,
In order to further improve quality, we have decided to postpone the event.

Due to this postponement, we would like to thank all the users who were looking forward to the game and everyone involved.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Season 2 is scheduled to be held within 2024, and more detailed dates will be provided.
We will notify you again as soon as we have decided on new content.

Currently, we are working on making the game lighter and updating the model, which has been requested by many people.
The entire development team is working hard to provide an even better game.
Thank you for your continued support until Project F Season 2 is held.

notes.title: バージョン0.3.13を配信しました。
notes.notes:
・8月17日24時 をもちましてシーズン1を終了いたしました。
・次回シーズンは3ヶ月後に開催予定です。
・アップデート内容は後日お知らせいたします。

■バトルパスについて
・シーズン1の閉幕と共に、シーズン1[Initiation]バトルパスは終了とさせていただきます。

■ゲームモードについて
以下のモードはオフシーズン中はクローズさせていただきます。
・3ラウンドマッチ
・ランクマッチ
※カスタムマッチは遊ぶことができます。

notes.title: Publish store page！
notes.notes:
The store page has been released on July 13, 2023!

"Project F" is a 5-on-5 tactical FPS game, where an attacking team and a defending team engage in a battle over a defensive target known as 'The monolith'.
The defending team positions the monolith anywhere within a building and defend it for a specific duration.
Otherwise, the attacking team need to complete the hacking of the monolith in time.
Both teams also win by annihilating all of the enemy teams.

We are currently making final adjustments for release!
Please wait a little longer until the release.
